recipient.label: the deploy smoke test's DEMO KEY (deployments/143.json)

context.retries: viem's HTTP transport retries a failed request inside a call; a call that made more HTTP requests than requestsPerCall is a failure, never a sample
context.percentiles: nearest-rank: the sample at rank ceil(p/100 * n), 1-based; every value is a measured sample

gas.source: eth_getTransactionReceipt and eth_getTransactionByHash on https://rpc.monad.xyz for the hashes in deployments/143.json

receipts.name: agentRegister
receipts.what: ERC-8004 register() of agent 10260 (the registry's gas, not Letterlock's)

receipts.name: publishForAgent
receipts.what: publishForAgent(10260, pub, 1): an agent's first key (reads the live registry)

receipts.name: publishForAgent epoch 2
receipts.what: publishForAgent(10260, pub, 2): the agent's key rotated to epoch 2
